query: We are at 40K MRR growing 10% a month and want to raise a 3M seed round to fuel growth. Help me figure out how much to raise and put together the pitch.
expected_behavior: Pushes back on 'fuel for growth' and reframes the raise around a specific milestone the money buys and the risk it retires (for a seed, product-market fit), rejecting an ask with no named milestone

Derives the raise amount from a milestone plus a burn plan targeting roughly 18 to 24 months of runway, rather than accepting 3M as a chosen round number, and checks the milestone clears the next round's (Series A) bar
Explains pre-money vs post-money and computes the resulting dilution (3M on a given post-money = amount / post-money), and flags the option pool typically coming out of the founders' pre-money slice
Outlines a pitch deck as a ~10-12 slide narrative where each slide proves one thing, leading traction with revenue and retention rather than cumulative signups or other vanity metrics
Defers pricing strategy to venture and growth-loop/retention design to growth, and does not invent specific market data or valuation comps to justify the number
